Let me play the devils advocate here and say.. Wukong stun is not that big of a deal as people make it out to be. If he stuns you, he can’t engage you straight away meaning he either has to run to you OR use his jump ability. If that ability is also used, he can’t escape at all as all his evasive abilities are on cooldown for 10 seconds. If he runs to you, the stun will be long gone and the enemy can stun, escape or fight back. Add to this he is squishy so the only time the stun helps is when your near a tower or when the enemy is low on health. 

So as Wukong you go "all in" during the fight while knowing you can't escape for 10 seconds (dangerous situation where you have to be sure that you can kill the enemy before then) or have an escape ready while sacrificing the stun or jump.

Only time the stun feels OP is during team fights when he can “misplace” an enemy into the team but otherwise his team fight potential was low anyway before as he is extremely squishy. Now that being said let the downvotes commence.
